payload.body: Verified existing FrickWorkspaceShell (NavigationComponents.kt) matches the workspace-shell spec: NavigationSuiteScaffold adaptive nav, NavigableListDetailPaneScaffold adaptive list/detail panes, ModalBottomSheet inspector on compact, semantic collection/content/inspector slots with app-owned state. Tests already cover destination contract + adaptive breakpoints. No behavior change needed.
